item.title: Richmond County Schools goes over bonds for school construction
item.description: The Richmond County School District currently has 24 building projects, noted Jeff Baker, director of RCBOE’s construction program, to the school board during its Committees Meeting, Tuesday night. item.title: Augusta city golf course reopening with Augusta National, Tiger Woods upgrades
item.description: The Augusta public can get a glimpse of long-awaited renovations at Augusta Municipal Golf Course when the club and the new “Loop at the Patch” reopen this spring. item.title: OPINION: PBM “Reform” in Name Only
item.description: In an opinion column, John Morris argues that Rep. Rick Allen’s claim of “significant” PBM reforms in the latest appropriations bill is misleading, saying the provisions are narrow, Medicare-only, and delayed for years. The post OPINION: PBM “Reform” in Name Only appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Battle for the Paddle rivalry game set for March 25 at SRP Park
item.description: SRP Park, in partnership with the University of South Carolina Aiken Pacers and the Augusta University Jaguars, announced the return of the Battle for the Paddle rivalry baseball game on Wednesday, March 25. The post Battle for the Paddle rivalry game set for March 25 at SRP Park appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Four caregivers suspended after alleged attack on disabled man in Grovetown
item.description: Four staff members at an assisted living facility in Grovetown have been suspended after authorities say they flipped a resident’s mattress while he was lying on it and then attacked him, leaving him with multiple injuries. The post Four caregivers suspended after alleged attack on disabled man in Grovetown appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: New townhome complex proposed for downtown
item.description: A pedestrian-friendly complex of townhomes downtown is among the latest projects Richmond County is slated to consider aiming to tackle housing in the area. The post New townhome complex proposed for downtown appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Wright draws reelection challenge from attorney Payne in May race
item.description: Incumbent Superior Court Judge Ashley Wright will face a reelection challenge this spring from Augusta attorney Alexia Davis Payne in the May 19 nonpartisan contest. The post Wright draws reelection challenge from attorney Payne in May race appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Neighbors question QTS plan for Augusta’s first data center
item.description: About 200 people packed a public meeting Wednesday to question the impact and handling of what would be Augusta’s first commercial data center. The post Neighbors question QTS plan for Augusta’s first data center appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Anonymous video sparked probe that led to AU women’s golf coach’s firing
item.description: Augusta University terminated women’s golf head coach Ember Holloway in October 2025 after an internal investigation began with an anonymously submitted video and concluded she violated the university’s Amorous Relationships policy, according to human resources records. The post Anonymous video sparked probe that led to AU women’s golf coach’s firing appeared first on The Augusta Press.
